_comment: Known consumers of the standards release channel (standards/v<major>-stable). `cut-standards-release.sh verify <ref>` runs each one against a candidate commit before a promotion (#1173). Add a row for every new STANDARDS_CHANNEL / PERSONA_SCHEMA_CHANNEL reader. Fields: id; repo (owner/name, checked out at its default branch); ref_env (the env var that pins the consumer to the candidate commit); command (run with `bash -c` from the consumer checkout); expect_output / reject_output (extended regexes over the combined output — a zero exit alone is not a pass, because a consumer that could not read the candidate may skip its checks and still exit 0).

consumers.description: repo-template drift guard: every seeded stub must match its emission at the candidate.
consumers.reject_output: DRIFTED	|::error|Could not compute the standards-derived content

consumers.description: Persona manifests must validate against the persona schema at the candidate. Needs Python >= 3.10 with jsonschema and pyyaml; set PYTHON to choose the interpreter.
